spans.s:
Dabhīti appears several times in the Rigveda as a hero or sage. indra overcomes on his behalf cumuri and dhuni; he pressed soma for indra, who rewarded him. For him 30,000 Dāsas were sent to sleep, and for him the Dasyus were bound without cords. dabhīti also appears, with turvīti, as a protégé of the Aśvins. There seems no reason to deny that he was a real person.
